# Contributing

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md). Repository foundation plus the isolated deny-only admin console scaffold from PenniLogic/admin#1; no administrative identity provider, features or authentication are implemented.

Install Python 3.14, Git, and Node 24.14.0 (see `.nvmrc`), then run:

```text
python scripts/setup.py
python scripts/check_repository.py
npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
npm run lint
npm run typecheck
npm run check:imports
npm test
npm run build
npm run smoke
```

Repository-specific setup, commands and troubleshooting are maintained by hand in
[docs/scaffold.md](docs/scaffold.md); that guide is not generated.

`CI` runs on standard GitHub-hosted Ubuntu for pushes and pull requests, including
forks, with read-only permissions and no repository secrets. Actions are SHA-pinned.
Workflow/config files generated here use JSON syntax, a valid YAML subset, so
the stdlib checker can validate them without installing a second parser.

Branches and small PRs remain required after the initial import. Record two
self-reviews and separate agent review. Do not request self-approval from the
only GitHub user. Apply specialist review to the changed risks. Preserve failures;
do not manufacture reports, check results or reviewer identities.

Generated setup is maintained in `PenniLogic/infra/governance`. Development builds
and tests belong in this repository as its implementation is added.
